name: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk
summary: PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in software publishing and digital product sales businesses in Indonesia. It operates through five segments: Digital Products, IRS Software, Advertisement, Commission, and Digital Marketing Services. The Digital Products segment provides information technology solutions to support customers' digitalization needs. Its IRS Software segment develops revenue management systems to improve operational efficiency and support financial reporting requirements.
